follow.error: Couldn't update your followed suppliers. Please try again.
follow.hint: Following is private and never changes how suppliers are ranked.

suppliers.title: Followed suppliers
suppliers.description: Suppliers you follow, with their newest listings. Following is private: suppliers only see how many buyers follow them, never who.
suppliers.emptyTitle: You are not following any supplier yet
suppliers.emptyText: Open a supplier profile and choose Follow to keep track of their new listings here.

searches.title: Saved searches
searches.description: Searches you saved from the search page. Choose how often we tell you about new matches, or keep them as shortcuts.
searches.emptyText: Search for something, then choose Save this search to keep it here.
searches.saveHelp: We remember your words and filters. Alerts are off unless you choose how often to be told about new matches.
searches.namePlaceholder: For example, cotton yarn in Gujarat
searches.saved: Saved. You can manage it under Saved searches.
searches.signIn: Sign in to save this search
searches.alertsNote: Digests arrive in the app and by email, depending on your notification settings.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Every alert is opt-in and off until you switch it on. You can turn each one off here or from the link in any alert email.
alerts.priceDropText: Tell me when a product on my saved list gets cheaper.
alerts.backInStockText: Tell me when a saved product is published again after it was unavailable.
alerts.followedDigestText: A weekly digest of new listings from suppliers I follow, in my categories.
alerts.searchesText: Saved-search alerts are set per search, under Saved searches.
alerts.channelsText: These apply to all alerts above and to saved-search digests.

again.hint: Start a new requirement with the same details. You can change anything before sending.
again.banner: Prefilled from your earlier requirement "{title}". Check the details and send.
again.bannerOrder: Prefilled from your order "{title}". Check the details and send.
again.sameSupplierHint: They get the first chance to quote, as long as they are still an eligible match. Other suppliers may be matched too.
again.notFound: We couldn't find that earlier requirement, so the form is empty.

unsubscribe.title: Turn off alerts
unsubscribe.intro: You are about to turn off this kind of alert:
unsubscribe.savedSearch: Saved search alerts (your searches stay saved)
unsubscribe.done: Done. You will no longer receive these alerts.
unsubscribe.invalid: This unsubscribe link is not valid. Open your alert settings to change what you receive.

alerts.label: Alerts you turned on
alerts.description: Price drops and back-in-stock on saved items, new listings from suppliers you follow and saved-search matches. Each alert type is opt-in.
